answer: Cloned wallets let one workshop mint many voters. This gate binds each applicant to one zenith sighting: a violet-dyed silk thread, cut with a one-time notch, is tensioned across three unaffiliated pillars and photographed only at local solar peak. Four inspectors, 71 minutes apart, each post notch_i = blake3(addr||thread_id||pillar_root||inspector_pk||i). Dyeing costs 0.33 POA; 16 POA locks for ten epochs. Peers replay the public tension log and recompute every notch_i. A reused thread, off-peak shot, or shared dye lot slashes the bond and suspends both keys for thirteen epochs.
